items.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Input is reference identity of the SAME Chinese child archer from Nine Tripod Cauldrons. Create a production animation atlas of LOWER BODY ONLY, cut cleanly at the black waist belt, NO heads, torso, hands, scarves, bows or ground shadows. Ivory tunic hem below belt, indigo loose trousers, dark leather shoes with cream bindings. Chinese shadow-puppet/woodblock print finish, carved dark contours, restrained linen/pixel grain; match the reference design precisely. Actual transparent background. Exactly FOUR columns (facing RIGHT, DOWN toward viewer, LEFT, UP away), EIGHT rows in chronological running cycle: right foot contact, down/compression, right foot passing, flight, left foot contact, down/compression, left foot passing, flight. Distinct continuous anatomical poses, not two poses repeated. Elevated isometric 3/4 camera matching reference. All 32 lower bodies same body scale and clothing, waist at consistent column center, no horizontal drift, feet vary naturally through gait. Broad rectangular canvas, generous 20px transparent gutters between cells, each pose wholly in its cell, 4 x 8 evenly spaced cells. No labels, grid, text, glow, duplicates inside cells or background. This is for compositing under the existing independently aiming upper body.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production GAME GROUND background for Nine Tripod Cauldrons, a Chinese myth Tanggu isometric action RPG. Landscape 16:9 composition, fixed elevated isometric orthographic camera, purely horizontal flat walkable ground with NO vertical objects. A large connected clearing: left safe ash-soil path, central ruined stone corridor with worn square flagstones, right broad ritual battle courtyard with faint sunbird geometric carving. Interconnected wide routes, open fighting space, readable low-noise center. Edges fade into dark earthy burnt woodland floor, ochre-grey basalt, subdued bronze-gold inlays, restrained teal-grey moss, scattered tiny grass/stone pebbles, ink woodcut contours and fine pixel/stipple grain. Same premium Chinese shadow-puppet / hand-carved woodblock material world as an ivory-clothed indigo-trousered child with red scarf. Ground-only plate filling every pixel edge-to-edge; keep architecture, pillars, walls, altars, roots and all trees OUT because separately layered sprites will be placed in-engine. No trees, buildings, enemies, humans, shadows of absent objects, arrows, sky, horizon, labels, HUD, text, symbols that resemble UI, watermark. No painterly glossy 3D. Lighting from upper left softly warm. Intended world 2560 x 1440, details should still read at 1280 x 720 camera size. Large handcrafted route from left to right, not a screenshot or mockup.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite atlas for ONE consistent enemy archetype, Tanggu SHADOW PUPPET melee warrior, matching a Chinese myth shadow-puppet/woodblock print isometric action RPG with a red-scarf child archer. A lanky folded ash-paper humanoid in charcoal grey lamellar strips, small tarnished bronze sunbird mask with narrow warm red eye slits, ragged ink-black sash, one short broken bronze blade. Menacing readable small silhouette, not a boss, no horns or ornate fantasy cape. Ink-carved dark outlines, muted ochre edge highlights, linen grain and restrained pixel stipple, elevated orthographic 3/4 view, light upper left. Actual alpha transparency; no opaque backdrop, cast ground shadow, captions, effects or UI. Exactly FOUR columns (facing RIGHT / DOWN / LEFT / UP) and SEVEN rows: idle, walk right foot forward, walk left foot forward, telegraph raised blade held ready with torso coiled, active broad melee swing, recovery blade lowered, recoiling wounded collapsing into paper fragments. Maintain identical body scale, mask, limb proportions and blade in every cell; last row includes a collapsing body readable as death. Each cell wholly separate with generous transparent gutters, all full figures including feet and weapon in cell. Wide landscape atlas, 4x7 layout, no grid or labels, no arrows, bows, child characters, scenery, duplicate figures inside cells. This is a functional game asset, not a concept poster.

Use case: stylized-concept. A production transparent ENVIRONMENT PROP ATLAS for Tanggu, Chinese myth isometric action RPG. Six isolated assets arranged in EXACT THREE columns by TWO rows with ample transparent gutters, no overlap. Top left: a tall ancient fusang tree with dark twisted trunk and sparse muted bronze-copper leaf crown, roots meeting a small ground footpoint; top middle: a broad gnarled burnt root arch lying low along the ground, walk-blocking; top right: a short ruined stone wall with broken stepped top, dark ink joints and small archaic bronze ornament. Bottom left: one square ancient basalt stone pillar with sunbird carved face, worn beveled cap, simple diamond base; bottom middle: an elaborate low Sunbird altar, rounded bronze disc above a low stone plinth, 3/4 isometric, no flame or light effects; bottom right: a small cluster of basalt stones and sparse dull grass, suitable for repeated decoration. SAME elevated isometric orthographic angle, upper-left warm lighting, ochre grey rock, very subdued teal bronze, black-brown bark. Premium Chinese shadow-puppet / woodblock-print cut contours and crisp restrained pixel/stipple texture, not glossy 3D or watercolor. Actual alpha transparent background, each sprite independent including all top/bottom details, no ground plate except tiny contact base integral to prop, no cast ground shadows (separate in-engine). Props occupy their cells, nothing crosses gutters. No text, labels, frame borders, humans, enemies, HUD, arrows, magical glow, sky, perspective horizon. Wide canvas, ensure detailed readable shapes at small game sizes.

Use case: identity-preserve. Reference image is the SAME Chinese child archer identity. Create UPPER BODY ONLY transparent sprite atlas for a shadow-puppet woodblock-print isometric game, from head/topknot to bottom of BLACK WAIST BELT, no pelvis, legs, bows, arrows, strings or effects. Exactly FOUR columns, RIGHT / DOWN / LEFT / UP facing elevated 3/4 orthographic; exactly FOUR rows: 1 strong piercing-shot windup with rear elbow fully drawn and stern focused expression, invisible bow hand extended at steady grip; 2 arrow-rain casting with both arms lifted to aim an invisible bow skyward, looking up; 3 dodge crouch with scarf trailing and body leaning low forward while keeping waist registration; 4 injured and defeated, hunched with one hand gripping torso, head bowed and eyes closed. Ivory crossed-lapel linen tunic, dark cuffs, black belt with small bronze ring, indigo hint above belt only, vermilion scarf kept entirely above waist, black topknot hair, youthful same child face and proportions as reference. Same scale in all cells, belt centered at consistent anchor, generous transparent gutters, no sprite crosses its cell. 4x4 orderly atlas, no text/grid/labels/background/ground shadows. Fine carved ink contours, linen folds, controlled stipple/pixel grain, warm ochre highlights, no glossy anime, not adult. Genuine alpha transparency. The separately rendered bow must not be painted into any pose.

Use case: identity-preserve. Reference is the lower-body run-cycle atlas for the SAME Chinese child archer. Generate a matching IDLE STANDING lower-body-only atlas, exactly FOUR isolated poses in ONE horizontal ROW: facing right, toward viewer/down, left, away/up. Same ink-carved shadow-puppet style, exact indigo trousers, dark shoes with ivory bindings, black belt with bronze ring, short IVORY TUNIC HEM below belt matching the running reference. Both feet planted in a relaxed ready stance, no running, same proportions/scale in all four poses. Only belt, tunic hem, trousers, legs and shoes. No torso, head, hands, scarf, weapons, text, labels, grid, shadows or background. Genuine alpha transparency. Each figure wholly isolated, plenty of transparent margin. Waist belt stable at same height. Landscape 4:1 sprite strip suitable for game compositing under separately aiming upper body.

Use case: identity-preserve. Reference is the SAME child archer identity from Nine Tripod Cauldrons. Production transparent game sprite strip of a NON-GORY DEFEATED/KNEELING pose: the same young Chinese child with black topknot, ivory crossed-lapel tunic, indigo loose trousers, dark bound shoes and vermilion long scarf. Both knees down on the ground, body slumped forward, head bowed, one hand braced lightly on ground and the other resting on knee, exhausted and unable to fight. NO bow or arrows. Exactly FOUR separate full-body sprites in ONE horizontal row: facing RIGHT, DOWN/toward viewer, LEFT, UP/away, elevated isometric orthographic 3/4 view. Same scale/identity across poses, complete head/hair/scarf/knees/shoes in each cell, generous transparent gutters. Match premium carved-ink Chinese shadow-puppet / woodblock finish, linen folds, warm ochre highlights, restrained fine stipple pixel grain. Genuine alpha transparency, no ground or cast shadow, scenery, UI, text, labels, grid, gore, injury marks, halo, duplicated figures or background. This is the playable child in a failed training encounter, not an adult warrior or corpse.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target is the supplied shadow puppet atlas. Preserve EXACT enemy design, bronze sunbird mask, charcoal folded paper/lamellar strips, broken bronze blade, carved ink texture, palette and upper-left light. The old atlas has insufficient gutters: some recovery feet touch death sprites. Re-layout and refine into EXACT SEVEN COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS on a wide landscape atlas. Each ROW is one facing: right / down toward viewer / left / up away. The SEVEN COLUMNS are chronological states: idle, run step right foot forward, run step left foot forward, blade-raised locked telegraph, sweeping active melee strike, settled lowered-blade recovery with slight hurt flinch, collapsed paper-fragment death. Thus 28 distinct sprites. Each cell should have very generous 24px transparent gutters on ALL sides, bodies only 65% of cell height, weapon wholly inside its cell. Maintain same body scale, foot baseline at 80% cell height and body center at cell horizontal center in every pose. No sprite or fragment touches another cell. Keep all heads, masks, feet and blade tips complete. True alpha transparent background, no shadows/gradient/halo, ground, text, labels, grid or borders. Character stays a lanky paper shadow humanoid, not a new enemy or boss. Prioritize clean separable functional animation frames over filling the canvas.
